name: X-linked Intellectual Disability-Macrocephaly-Macroorchidism Syndrome
aliases: X-linked Intellectual Disability with Macrocephaly and Macroorchidism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for XLID-Macrocephaly-Macroorchidism Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of moderate to severe intellectual disability
Head circumference greater than 2 standard deviations above the mean for age and sex
Behavioral abnormalities including autistic features or hyperactivity
X-linked pattern of inheritance with affected males in multiple generations

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: intellectual disability, macrocephaly, and macroorchidism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing confirming pathogenic variants in associated X-linked genes supports diagnosis

laboratory: Possible elevated serum FSH and LH in post-pubertal males
imaging: Brain MRI may show mild ventriculomegaly or white matter abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in X-linked genes associated with intellectual disability (e.g., OPHN1, FMR1 negative)
X-linked inheritance pattern confirmed by family studies
other: Behavioral assessments indicating autistic features or hyperactivity

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of CGG repeat expansion in FMR1 gene
Characteristic facial features including long face and large ears

redFlags: Family history of X-linked intellectual disability
references: OMIM Entry - Intellectual Disability, X-linked, with Macrocephaly and Macroorchidism
Clinical Genetics Journal, 2023: Phenotypic Spectrum of XLID-Macrocephaly-Macroorchidism Syndrome
